chapter: Learning violin and banjo in New Orleans
title: Switching to banjo and rehearsing with George Morris, Thomas Mack and Edmund Washington
summary: Sayles explains how he took over his brother's banjo while his friends, all pupils of Dave Perkins, had trumpet, trombone and clarinet lessons and rehearsed together.
